name: A Saint for Me — House Style v2 (after juujuumama)
summary: Contemporary devotional art in the hand of artist juujuumama: torn-paper collage over faded mid-century snapshots flooded with thick hot-pink and red impasto, iridescent crystal blooms, banded agate, cut-out found-word strips, and Afrofuturist portraiture, in flood red, bubblegum pink, turquoise, lavender and cream.

palette.rules: Hot red-pink paint is the signature: it floods vintage scenes like a sea. Turquoise breaks through as torn openings. Lavender and iridescent opal for crystals and blooms. Cream paper and faded photo tones as ground. Gold only as a single sun disk or small accents.

techniques: thick impasto paint applied over vintage photographs, flooding landscapes and rooms like a sea
torn-paper collage with white deckled edges and visible layers
faded mid-century snapshot photography (suburban houses, gardens, family tables) as the base layer
cut-out found-word strips arranged like ransom-note poetry
iridescent holographic crystals, opal and geodes
banded agate and marbled mineral swirls
tufted, knitted and fuzzy textile textures in checkered patterns

preferences: bold central symbol with generous negative space
asymmetric balance, slightly tilted cut-out layers
depth built from physical layering rather than digital blur
an arch, window or halo shape used as a framing device
one clear focal point readable at phone size

a large slice of banded agate in turquoise, coral, lavender and cream, with a small sacred symbol at its heart

a tall Gothic-arch window cut from paper, opening onto a surreal celestial landscape

a mandala-like rose window of radial stained-glass petals and gems

lighting.atmosphere: luminous through color, not glow: light comes from saturated hues, gemstone facets and stained glass, with gentle paper shadows
lighting.avoid: lens flares, god rays, glowing haze, bloom effects

typography.inImage: AI-generated images contain no text (it comes out garbled). Real found-word strips, cut from the prayer, are added as an overlay by the studio-sketch artist.
typography.onCards: high-contrast serif display (Fraunces) for titles; prayer set in italic serif; small caps for labels; generous margins

sacredIconographyRules: Every artwork centers a saint or angel as a stylized collage figure: never photorealistic, never presented as a likeness.
Saints wear halos; only angels (such as the archangels and guardian angels) have wings.
Saints carry their correct traditional attributes.
Use only accurate Christian symbols; never invent pseudo-religious symbols or add occult or esoteric signs.
No cherubs or generic winged women.
Saint portraits are artistic interpretations, not historical likenesses.
avoid: glowing heavenly backgrounds, sunbeams through clouds
overly literal depictions of the user's situation
money, coins, banknotes or price tags
photorealism, 3D render look, plastic CGI sheen

referenceNotes: Signature move: an ordinary, faded mid-century photograph is overtaken by thick, glossy hot-pink and red paint that floods the scene like water, with turquoise showing through torn gaps.
Favor tactile, hand-made surfaces: impasto ridges, torn deckled paper, tufted yarn, plaster relief. Nothing should look smooth or digital.
Crystals and flowers are iridescent and holographic (opal, pink-lavender-aqua shifts), never plain glass.
